title: Should Belgians Install an Advanced Energy Management System in Their Electrified Dwelling ?
abstract: arXiv:2611.26441v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As dwellings electrify and more complex electricity pricing spreads in Belgium, the question arises: What are the potential benefits of installing an advanced energy management systems in an electrified Belgian dwelling ?   To answer this question, we simulate 500 representative Belgian dwellings in which fossil systems are replaced by controllable electric technologies: space heating via air-to-air heat pumps, domestic hot water via electric boilers, and private transport via electric vehicles with home chargers. Photovoltaic systems are assigned according to current adoption rates.   We evaluate two advanced energy management systems (EMS): model predictive control (MPC) and TreeC, a machine learning method using decision trees to model the EMS strategy. These are compared to a rule-based controller (RBC) that mimics default operation and an MPC with perfect forecasts (MPC P) as an upper bound. Performance for these EMSs is assessed

translated_title: 比利时人应该在电气化住宅中安装先进能源管理系统吗？
translated_abstract: 随着住宅电气化的推进以及更复杂电价机制在比利时的普及，一个问题随之而来：在电气化的比利时住宅中安装先进能源管理系统有哪些潜在收益？为回答这一问题，我们模拟了500户具有代表性的比利时住宅，其中化石燃料系统被可调控的电力技术所取代：采用空气-空气热泵进行供暖、电锅炉提供生活热水、以及配备家用充电桩的电动汽车满足私人出行需求。光伏系统则按照当前的普及率进行配置。我们评估了两种先进能源管理系统（EMS）：模型预测控制（MPC）以及一种使用决策树来建模EMS策略的机器学习方法TreeC。这两种方法与模拟默认运行方式的基于规则的控制器（RBC）以及具有完美预测的MPC（MPC P，作为性能上限）进行比较，并对这些EMS的性能进行评估。
tldr: 本研究通过模拟500户比利时电气化住宅，评估模型预测控制（MPC）与基于决策树的TreeC等先进能源管理系统相比传统规则控制器，在热泵供暖、电热水和电动汽车充电场景下的潜在收益。
en_tdlr: This study simulates 500 representative Belgian electrified dwellings to evaluate the potential benefits of advanced energy management systems (MPC and the decision-tree-based TreeC) compared to rule-based control for heat pump heating, electric hot water, and electric vehicle charging.
